title: 12회 3번 · 어법상 틀린 것 찾기
fullPassage: With the massive amount of information presented by various media outlets in today’s world, it is becoming increasingly challenging for the public to distinguish reliable news stories from unreliable ones. While many believe that providing media literacy education to people is the solution, there is a growing recognition that journalists also have a significant role to play in guiding them. The most important consideration for journalists should be that their news reports are clear and readily understandable to audiences. Those who search for news to inform themselves about the latest developments usually have questions in their mind about what is new, what evidence is available, what is now unknown, and so on. What journalists should do is anticipate their audience’s questions and try to answer them explicitly rather than just assuming that they will discover the clues embedded in the stories. For example, news writers may present those questions and answers in a highly visible manner at the top of the articles, using elements like boxes and bullet points. This way, journalists can help audiences not only understand the news with ease but also engage with it in a critical manner.
